t: The Jello Wobble: AI Embodiment and the Age of Intuitive Machines
s: This article re-evaluates AI embodiment, contrasting LLMs' symbolic thought with visual models' intuitive "world model" (e.g., "jello wobble"). It argues AI, though lacking human bodies, possesses "derived qualia" through digital sensors and API actuators, acting as a "dry-run" for a digitally embodied Asimovian future.
sub: AI's digital embodiment vs. "Brain in a Vat"
